items.question: By what count and in what kind of womb-diagrams are certain beings said to be tormented?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the setting.
That count applies to thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings are described as tormented within those womb-diagrams.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of those tormented beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: In eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams, beings are tormented.
